name: Scavio
description: Structured web data for OpenClaw agents across 31 platforms with one API key: search, page extraction, and first-party commerce, social, travel, jobs, real-estate, app-store, software-review, ad-library and company-filing data.

apiKey.title: Scavio API key
apiKey.description: Your Scavio API key from https://scavio.dev. Format: sk_ followed by 64 hex characters.

platforms.title: Platform allowlist
platforms.description: Which Scavio platforms register tools. Unset registers the default surface: 106 tools across 11 platforms. Additive, e.g. 'default,zillow,sec'. 'all' registers 191 tools - a large payload in every session.
